entities.name: Javin
entities.description: Argivian archaeologist and last living member of the Circle who excavated old Sumifa.

entities.name: Circle
entities.description: Order Javin was the last member of.

entities.name: Porros
entities.description: Dark prince, Javin's distant ancestor and Cheyne's enemy.

entities.name: Cheyne
entities.description: Javin's foster son who found the Holy Book of the Confessors.

entities.name: Thedeso
entities.description: King of Sumifa who died during the excavation.

entities.name: Samor
entities.description: Buried figure Javin hoped to find.

entities.name: Vashki
entities.description: Claria's former servant who picked up the holy book.

entities.name: Luquin
entities.description: Elf healer who cured Javin's scorpion poison.

events.summary: Javin discovers a reference to buried Sumifa and is sent to excavate it with Cheyne.
events.quote: Javin discovered a reference to the buried city of old Sumifa

events.summary: Cheyne finds the holy book and fights assassins sent by Riolla Hifrata.
events.quote: It was Cheyne who found the book

events.summary: Javin reveals to Cheyne that his spell protected Cheyne from Porros, then passes out from a scorpion sting.
events.quote: Javin then passed out from his injury

events.summary: Luquin cures Javin of the scorpion poison.
events.quote: who cured Javin of the scorpion poison

relations.quote: He was a distant descendant of the dark prince
